contracts.signal: MediaTek's flagship Dimensity 9500 platform, built on TSMC's 3nm process, powers Samsung's new Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Galaxy Tab S12+ tablets; Samsung SVP of Product Management Drew Blackard confirmed the Dimensity 9500 powers the Galaxy Tab S12 series. The Dimensity 9500-powered Galaxy Tab S12 series will be available at all major retailers starting on Monday, October 7.
